text:
incident-bot: Severity P1 -> high error rate on gpu-serving-prod-1 pool detected (container crashloop). Pager triggered.
Maya Chen: I’m on it. seeing continuous CrashLoopBackOff on runtime-engine pods in gpu-serving-prod-1.
Ranjit Singh: grabbing logs now. running `kubectl -n prod logs runtime-engine-5k9p -c runtime --previous`
Alex Park: I see repeated segfaults in the logs: `runtime_engine!main +0x1a3` followed by `FATAL: Aborted (signal 6)`. also multiple `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` entries.
Maya Chen: stack from last crash paste: ```#0 0x7f9e8b4a in runtime::kernel::execute()+0x2d
#1 0x7f9e8b12 in runtime::serve_loop()+0x1f4
#2 0x4009a3 in main+0x5b
Thread 1 (most recent call first): Segmentation fault (core dumped)```
ops-pager: Customer impact: ~20% of hosted inference requests returning 500s in us-west-2 for small-L models. Ticket count spiking.
Sara Lopez: Can we divert traffic to gpu-serving-prod-2? Are variants compatible?
Ranjit Singh: gpu-serving-prod-2 has older kernel build but compatible CPU fallback exists. I'll request routing to fallback variant via router override.
Alex Park: For immediate mitigation we should: 1) cordon + drain the affected nodes 2) scale down runtime-engine deployment to 0 for affected pool and flip to CPU-fallback model group 3) collect core dumps & full backtraces for eng-runtime.
Maya Chen: Starting node drain: `kubectl drain gw-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Maya Chen: Node drain in progress — pod eviction taking a few seconds, but containers keep restarting while kubelet tries to kill them.
eng-runtime-rotator: FYI I'll start a live debug session. please capture `/var/crash/*.core` and `dmesg | tail -n 80`. Also enable debug-logging on runtime (level=trace) temporarily.
Ranjit Singh: Collected dmesg snippet: ```[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, Ch 0000000a, intr 10000000. Copy engine fault.
[ 12345.679002] oom-killer: killing process 31789 (runtime-engine) total-vm: ...
[ 12345.679103] runtime-engine[31789]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f9e8b4a sp ...```
Maya Chen: Starting a temporary router override to route 100% of small-L traffic to CPU fallback (config id: ro-2026-04-15-01). Alex, please confirm rollout.
Alex Park: Confirmed. Applied override. Observability: 500s for small-L dropped from 22% -> 4% within 90s. :thumbsup:
ops-pager: Noted. Opening a customer comms draft to CSMs. Will flag customers impacted and note mitigation steps.
Sara Lopez: We still need root cause. eng-runtime, can you reproduce locally with a smaller harness?
eng-runtime-rotator: We're starting with a minimized reproducer. Hypothesis: a boundary check missing in fused attention kernel causes illegal memory access under specific sequence lengths + mixed-precision + TRTexec path.
Maya Chen: Collected core dump uploaded to /tmp/incident-4105551234/core-31789.gz and GDB backtrace saved. Sharing snippet: ```#0 0x7f9e8b4a in fused_attention::compute()+0x2d
#1 0x7f9e8b12 in runtime::kernel::execute()+0x1f4
#2 0x4009a3 in main+0x5b```
Ranjit Singh: There's also a quantization path enabled on these nodes (int8). Disabling quant path on prod pool as a test.
Alex Park: I applied a hot config to disable int8 quantization profile on gpu-serving-prod-1 (config change id qc-410555-A). Observability: crash rate reduced but not eliminated.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation=route-fallback, node-drain, int8-disable; assigned=eng-runtime, severity=P1; incident_channel=#incidents/4105551234.
Maya Chen: Preparing to scale runtime-engine replica set down to 0 for the pool to stop noisy restarts while we iterate.
Sara Lopez: Also let's pin an older runtime image for a canary in prod-2 to see if regression introduced in latest image is the culprit.
eng-runtime-rotator: We're bisecting between v9.2.1 and v9.3.0 builds. v9.2.1 doesn't show segfaults in our unit harness. v9.3.0 reproduces with the fused-kernel enabled.
Maya Chen: Rolling runtime-engine in prod-2 back to v9.2.1 for canary. Command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/runtime-engine runtime=redwood/runtime:v9.2.1 --record`
Alex Park: Canary running. no segfaults observed on canary for 12m. Good signal.
Ranjit Singh: Collecting artifacts for postmortem: kernel config, docker image diffs, compile flags, `nvcc` versions, reproducer script.
ops-pager: Customer impact summary: Peak 500s ~ 28% for small-L, estimated 40k requests affected over 12m window. No data exfiltration. Customers on Dedicated unaffected (isolated pools).
Maya Chen: Escalating to engineering release manager to schedule hotfix rollback or patch release. Which path do we prefer? rollback to v9.2.1 across affected pools or cherry-pick fix for fused kernel?
eng-runtime-rotator: Prefer rollback + pinned image while we backport a fix — lower blast radius. We'll prepare a patch branch.
Sara Lopez: I'll draft the incident summary for customers: root cause suspected in fused attention kernel on v9.3.0 causing illegal memory access under int8 path; mitigation: traffic reroute to CPU fallback, rollback canary to v9.2.1, disable int8 quant on affected pool. ETA for full rollback across pools: 25m.
Maya Chen: Rolling out rollback to gpu-serving-prod-1 and prod-2 now. Monitoring.
Alex Park: After rollback, observed crash rate back to baseline and 500s at 0.7%. reclaiming capacity.
incident-bot: Incident resolved -> mitigated (rollback + config change). Please file a postmortem; severity downgraded to P2 pending RCA.
ops-pager: Noting follow-ups: postmortem, CVE-style checklist for fused kernel testing, enable more aggressive pre-deploy canary with fused kernels in sandbox, add watchdog to drop bad sequences.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll hand this to eng-runtime for RCA. Handoff to follow-on channel: #eng-runtime-4105551234.
Ranjit Singh: Leaving notes in the incident doc: `/docs/incidents/4105551234.md` with logs and commands used.
Alex Park: TL;DR: segfault in fused attention kernel under int8 path in v9.3.0 -> crashloops -> routed traffic to CPU fallback -> rollback to v9.2.1 fixed.
eng-runtime-rotator: We'll own the postmortem and patch. Adding owners: Ranjit, Alex, Priya (kernel), Omar (quant).
Maya Chen: closing local thread. If anything flares, re-open or ping @oncall. :white_check_mark:
